“I can feel it, just one step away from the Ninth Stage.”

The Lord of the Three Yin, with a flash of longing in his gaze, looked down at the numerous Evil Gods kneeling before him.

If he devoured these Evil Gods, he could advance even further.

The Lord of the Three Yin would not hesitate.

Unfortunately, for an Evil God to grow from the Eighth Layer to the Ninth, mere devouring was no longer significant; accumulation in other aspects was more necessary.

...

“My Spirit Will, with the aid of that Void Secret Realm, is already strong enough, but the perception of rules? We Evil Gods are born strong, what rules are there to perceive?”

The Lord of the Three Yin sighed.

Just then,

An Evil God below seemed to receive some information and immediately spoke up, “Great Lord, your subordinate ‘Black Demon’ has fallen outside of a world, according to intelligence.”

“Black Demon?”

The Lord of the Three Yin looked down, “So it’s him.”

More than a hundred thousand years ago, Black Demon had personally come outside the grand hall, submitting to the Lord of the Three Yin.

This was also a rule established by the Lord of the Three Yin: within the Three Yin Void Domain, all Evil Gods of a certain strength must come to pay homage to him.

Otherwise, they would be considered enemies of the Lord of the Three Yin.

“He also had a token to enter that Void Secret Realm; I didn’t expect him to die so soon.”

The Lord of the Three Yin thought to himself, having some recollection of the Black Demon Pavilion Master.

Because the Black Demon Pavilion Master and the Lord of the Three Yin were of the same path, they could both enter that mysterious Void Secret Realm.

However, the Lord of the Three Yin had entered the Void Secret Realm much earlier than the Black Demon Pavilion Master.

Of course, the Lord of the Three Yin was quite familiar with the Black Demon Pavilion Master, but the latter did not realize that his biggest secret had already been seen through by the Lord of the Three Yin.

The gap between their strengths was too vast.

“How did Black Demon die?”

The Lord of the Three Yin asked casually.

About that Void Secret Realm, it was no secret to the many lords of the Evil Gods within the Boundless Void; almost all of them held tokens and could come and go freely.

Besides, it was also possible for Evil Gods beneath the lords to obtain a token and thereby enter the Void Secret Realm.

The Lord of the Three Yin felt somewhat regretful at the moment. The Black Demon Pavilion Master had the means to enter and exit the Secret Realm, and his potential for future growth should not be low; perhaps he might have had a chance to come close to him?

Of course, the Lord of the Three Yin felt no sorrow. To him, the Black Demon Pavilion Master was merely a tool.

If the future growth was good, he could be put to use.

Even if he grew close to the lord tier of Evil Gods, the Lord of the Three Yin wouldn’t mind consuming him for a feast.

Devouring other Evil Gods didn’t help in becoming a Ninth Stage Evil God, but it was a delectable treat, especially the more powerful the Evil Gods were.

“Lord, please see, this is the memory image of the battle at that time.”

The Evil God below immediately raised his hand, and sequences of images emerged, showing the moment when Black Demon Pavilion Master and four other Evil Gods had come outside the Tianqing World, planning to attack from afar.

“Hm?”

The Lord of the Three Yin watched the memory images, his expression suddenly changing to incredulity, “They disappeared? I didn’t even see how they vanished?”

“What enemy did this Black Demon Pavilion Master provoke?” The Lord of the Three Yin was somewhat alarmed.

Although the memory images were from the spectating Evil Gods and couldn’t fully reproduce the real scene, the abrupt disappearance of Black Demon Pavilion Master and the four powerful Evil Gods still made the Lord of the Three Yin feel like facing a formidable enemy.

“It’s the rules; it must involve some kind of rules. The Evil God who acted against them is closer to the Ninth Stage than I am, perhaps a Ninth Stage Evil God?”

The Lord of the Three Yin’s heart was overwhelmed by huge waves.

Even if this was just speculation, and the Lord of the Three Yin had never seen the enemy with his own eyes, he couldn’t be certain whether it was a Ninth Stage Evil God who had acted.

But this was enough to make the Lord of the Three Yin’s heart tremble.

“Lord, what… what should we do now?” The kneeling Evil God below couldn’t help but ask.

In the Three Yin Void Domain, the Lord of the Three Yin was the absolute dominion. The disappearance of the Black Demon Pavilion Master, one of his subordinates, was equivalent to a slap in the face of the Lord of the Three Yin.

To command more Evil Gods, the Lord of the Three Yin would occasionally act to help subordinates avenge themselves.

Solely relying on absolute strength could not make all Evil Gods completely submit; at times, it was necessary to show ‘favor’ and ‘benefits’.

“What to do?”

The Lord of the Three Yin looked troubled. Regardless of whether the entity that struck against Black Demon Pavilion Master was a Ninth Stage Evil God or not, it was undoubtedly stronger than the Lord of the Three Yin himself.

“Tell all Evil Gods within my Three Yin Void Domain to avoid that area.” After a moment of silence, the Lord of the Three Yin immediately commanded.

With such an entity appearing in his domain, the Lord of the Three Yin felt helpless and could only restrict his subordinates as much as possible to avoid provocation.

“Avoid that area?”

Upon hearing this, the other Evil Gods below exchanged glances and immediately realized that the being who had struck against Black Demon Pavilion Master must be of immense strength; otherwise, the great Lord of the Three Yin would not back down.

…

Just over a month had passed.

Lin Yuan’s true body and the two Primordial Spirits’ Inner Worlds had already reached their zenith, each spanning two point three billion miles.

“Those vaguely watching Evil Gods, they’ve all disappeared?” Lin Yuan’s thoughts flickered as he looked beyond his World.

Ever since he had returned to the Tianqing World, with the invasion of ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream,’ Lin Yuan had felt the sensation of being watched from a distant location.

Other Evil Gods must be eyeing the Tianqing World.

This was quite normal; to the Evil Gods, the Tianqing World was like a delicious meal, even after the incident with Black Demon Pavilion Master and the other four Evil Gods.
